remarks: This spacious 1 bedroom has been recently painted, giving it a pleasingly modern and crisp aesthetic. The bathroom has been elegantly reinvigorated with a brand-new tile floor & a new modern vanity, adding an element of minimalist style to the space while maintaining high functionality. The condo's unique attraction, though, lies in the enormous combination garage-workspace. This specifically designed multipurpose tandem garage commands enough room to house two full-sized cars plus a giant work area and a separate, expansive storage room. The versatility of this space makes it an ideal option for contractors or hobbyists seeking an ample work environment. Part of living here is the absolute convenience it places at your footsteps. The property is positioned across the street from a hospital, making it easy to access healthcare. The location promotes a city-friendly lifestyle-it's a few strides away from bustling shopping complexes, a vast array of restaurants offering various cuisines and reliable transportation hubs. Imagine this combined with the vibrant neighborhood full of urban attractions, and you have a cozy living space that truly understands the modern lifestyle. Grab it before it's gone!
